hook_options: You should only hire a strategist or operator if you consider them your intellectual equal or superior in that domain. Otherwise, you just bought yourself a management job.
We do over a million in revenue, but here are the 3 reasons staffing is still our bottleneck.
The people you hired to save time are the reason you have none left.
Stop blaming your churn on the product when the real leak is who you hired to hold it.
You already know who on your team should not be there.

script.line: You should only hire a strategist or operator if you consider them your intellectual equal or superior in that domain. Otherwise, you just bought yourself a management job.
Measuring the risk of taking action while ignoring the risk of doing nothing is exactly what keeps people poorer than they ought to be.
You have to start taking more shots on goal, because most of what you call caution is just fear with better branding.
You hired for comfort instead of competence, and now comfort is running your company.
So — what is the actual cost of your business doing exactly what it did today for the next five years?
script.direction: Straight to camera, pause before delivering.
